title: Rav Ravai of Rov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was one of the Savoraim. He was from the town of Rov near Nehardea and lived for many years, as cited in the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, part 2, end of chapter 4.
He is also mentioned in the Gemara, Sanhedrin 43a, according to Rabbeinu Chananel’s reading, saying: “It is reasonable [that it is paid] from public funds.”
